name: compatibilityCounit_of_compatibilityUnit
statement: CompatibilityUnit adj e₁ e₂) : CompatibilityCounit adj e₁ e₂

name: compatibilityUnit_right
statement: CompatibilityUnit adj e₁ e₂) (Y : D) : e₂.inv.app Y = adj.unit.app _ ≫ G.map (e₁.hom.app _) ≫ G.map ((adj.counit.app _)⟦a⟧')

name: compatibilityCounit_left
statement: CompatibilityCounit adj e₁ e₂) (X : C) : e₁.hom.app X = F.map ((adj.unit.app X)⟦a⟧') ≫ F.map (e₂.inv.app _) ≫ adj.counit.app _

name: compatibilityUnit_isoAdd
statement: CompatibilityUnit adj e₁ e₂) (h' : CompatibilityUnit adj f₁ f₂) : CompatibilityUnit adj (Functor.CommShift.isoAdd e₁ f₁) (Functor.CommShift.isoAdd e₂ f₂)

name: shift_counit_app
statement: A) (Y : D) : (adj.counit.app Y)⟦a⟧' = (F.commShiftIso a).inv.app (G.obj Y) ≫ F.map ((G.commShiftIso a).inv.app Y) ≫ adj.counit.app (Y⟦a⟧)
